High Flow Balance 
 Valve (Air Reducing Valve)

This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1, which must be performed 
 every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block

High flow, balance valve is used where pneumatic equipment must be kept at 
 specified working pressures and where pneumatic operations could be affected by 
 line pressures fluctuation.

This document 
 initiated by eng. Mostafa Ahmed Shaban, reviewed & tested by eng. Albir Fayez 
 Gerges, eng. Mohamed Alsayed Ahmed, and approved by eng. Mohamed Salah Eldin Abd 
 Elghafar: general director of Wadi Hof Power Station.

This document 
 revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: CEPC quality control director, and 
 certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's 
 Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.

A 
work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, 
shoes, breathing-mask, safety glasses ... etc.
The gas turbine is out of service

Safety and healthy equipment as 
 safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, safety glasses ... etc.
Wrench 17
7/32 Allen Wrench.
Pointed probe
1/4-inch female gauge.

Maximum inlet pressure and operating temperature ratings are 300 psig and 
 200F.
Install as close as possible to where regulated air is needed.

Install the unit with the air flowing through the body in the direction 
 indicated by the arrow.

Install the same pipe size unit as the pipe line use avoid using fittings, 
 couplings, etc., that restrict the airflow, unless maximum flow is not needed.

Regulator may be installed so that adjusting handle is in any potation. Attach 
 gauge to one 1/4-inch female gauge port and plug the other l/4-inch female 
 port, or use it as a regulated outlet port.

Turning the adjusting screw in raises the regulated pressure and turning it 
 out lowers the regulated pressure

Panel mount regulators require a 3/4-inch diameter hole and are mountable on 
 panels from 1/8-inch to 9/16-inch thick

sections.text:
Occasionally remove bottom plug and clean (plug, body, valve seat and vent air 
 line on both sides of regulator). It is not necessary to remove 
 regulator from air line to do so.

items:
Shut off air to regulator and vent air line on both sides of regulator. Turn 
 adjusting screw out to relieve compression on spring. (Use 7/32-inch Allen 
 Wrench on tamper-resistant models) Remove screws, cover, spring, and spring 
 disk. Diaphragm assembly can now be removed. By removing bottom plug and 
 spring, the valve can be removed from the bottom of the regulator.

If unit will not be regulated to pressure needed or if pressure becomes excessive - remove bottom plug, spring and valve assembly. Clean and check 
 o-ring, valve stem and valve seat for water damage.

Replace worn or damaged parts. Install repair kit no. RRP-95-149 for 
 se1f-relieving models, and repairs Kit RRP-95-150 for non-relieving models for 
 complete overhaul
If unit leaks at relief port (A) - install proper repair kit as listed.

When replacing diaphragm Assembly- Diaphragm assembly RRP96-238 includes 
 relieving disk seal (not shown) installed Seal not required on non-relieving 
 models.

To replace o-ring GRP-78-023 This o-ring is above a metal washer which 
 cannot be removed. Using a pointed probe of some kind, pull o-ring out. Force 
 new ring through washer hole into o-ring cavity.
